errors.text: The proposed Ti-rich BCC/B2 or sigma phase does not reconstruct the experimentally relevant C14 Laves secondary phase.
The annealing-induced precipitation route conflicts with the target rapid-quenching route that stabilizes the as-cast fcc+C14 microstructure.
The cited evidence does not substantiate formation of a Ti-rich BCC phase in Fe-Co-Ni-Ti or its claimed exchange-hardening and orbital-moment effects.
Sigma phase is crystallographically distinct from an ordered BCC/B2 phase, so grouping them as interchangeable secondary phases makes the intervention structurally ambiguous.
